nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the current contract owner, set in the Ownable constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
IMOSToken.symbol: token ticker string, writable by reName (onlyOwner).
IMOSToken.name: human readable token name, writable by reName (onlyOwner).
IMOSToken.decimals: uint8 scaling factor set to 18 and used in 10**uint(decimals) computations.
IMOSToken._totalSupply: internal fixed supply minted to msg.sender in the constructor.
IMOSToken.balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
IMOSToken.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
Ownable() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) gate applied to transferOwnership and reName.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: validates newOwner != 0, emits OwnershipTransferred and overwrites owner.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b underflow check.
IMOSToken() constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, computes 500000000 * 10**uint(decimals), credits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
reName(string _symbol, string _name) onlyOwner: rewrites the symbol and name state variables.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): subtracts from balances[msg.sender], adds to balances[to] and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets the allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...).
multiTransfer(address[] _addresses, uint256[] amounts): loops over arrays calling transfer() for each entry.
multiTransferDecimals(address[] _addresses, uint256[] amounts): loops calling transfer() with amounts[i] * 10**uint(decimals).
Fallback function () public payable: unconditionally reverts so the contract never accepts ETH.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for the owner check, minting, balances and allowance writes.
balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens): balance decrement in transfer relying on SafeMath.sub underflow guard.
balances[to].add(tokens): balance increment in transfer relying on SafeMath.add overflow guard.
balances[from].sub(tokens) and allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens): allowance/balance decrement in transferFrom.
balances[to].add(tokens): recipient balance increment in transferFrom.
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]: raw unchecked subtraction in totalSupply() with no SafeMath guard.
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data): external call to an attacker-controlled address before state is finalised.
amounts[i] * 10**uint(decimals): unchecked per-element multiplication inside a loop.
500000000 * 10**uint(decimals): unchecked exponentiation/multiplication producing _totalSupply.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter _symbol of reName(string _symbol, string _name).
Parameter _name of reName(string _symbol, string _name).
Parameter to (recipient) of transfer(address to, uint tokens).

Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens).

Parameter to (credited account) of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).

Parameter tokens of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data).
Parameter data (bytes) forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Parameter _addresses of multiTransfer(address[] _addresses, uint256[] amounts).

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the Ownable constructor to initialise the owner.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier reads sv_owner to evaluate require(msg.sender == owner).
Ownership check compares caller-controlled msg.sender against the stored owner.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
reName is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter flows into the zero-address require and the owner assignment.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged owner state variable.
_symbol parameter is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_name parameter is assigned to the name state variable.
Owner-only reName rewrites the token symbol.
Owner-only reName rewrites the token name.
IMOSToken constructor credits the full supply to msg.sender.
Constructor initialises symbol = 'IMOS'.
Constructor initialises name = 'Intelligent Manufacturing Operation System'.
Constructor initialises decimals = 18.
Constructor writes the computed supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
Constructor performs 500000000 * 10**uint(decimals), an unchecked arithmetic operation producing the supply.
Result of the unchecked multiplication/exponentiation is stored in _totalSupply.
multiTransferDecimals evaluates amounts[i] * 10**uint(decimals) on each loop iteration.
The scaled amount is passed into transfer and ultimately debited from balances.
totalSupply() computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath or a bounds check.
The raw subtraction reads _totalSupply as its left operand.
The raw subtraction reads balances[address(0)] as its right operand.
totalSupply() returns data derived from the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
transfer executes balances[to].add(tokens).
transfer executes balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens).
Sender balance decrement writes into the balances mapping.
Recipient balance increment writes into the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the underflow-checked subtraction.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the overflow-checked addition.
transferFrom executes balances[from].sub(tokens) and allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens).
transferFrom executes balances[to].add(tokens).
Debit in transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
Credit in transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller the source of funds.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
tokens parameter of transfer is used in the balance arithmetic.
to parameter of transfer is the credited account.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens).
tokens parameter of approve becomes the allowance value.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
from parameter of transferFrom is the debited account.
to parameter of transferFrom is the credited account.
tokens parameter of transferFrom drives the balance and allowance arithmetic.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in balances[from].sub(tokens).
to/Tokens parameters feed balances[to].add(tokens).
spender parameter of approveAndCall selects the allowance entry.
tokens parameter of approveAndCall is the approved amount.
data parameter of approveAndCall is forwarded to the external callback.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into spender.receiveApproval, handing control to an untrusted contract.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' value into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
While the external call executes, the allowed allowance state can still be observed/modified, enabling reentrancy on the allowance.
The spender parameter is the address targeted by the external receiveApproval call.

amounts array parameter of multiTransfer supplies each transfer amount.

Loop index i indexes _addresses and amounts in multiTransfer.

amounts array parameter of multiTransferDecimals is scaled and transferred.
